jobs.title: Head of Creative
jobs.description:
Head of Creative

Department:
Marketing
Reports to:
CMO
Location:
London Bridge, London (hybrid)
Role Type:
Full-time, permanent

About Us

At Cambridge Audio, we're a different sort of global audio company, resolutely independent and always authentic.
We're on a mission to break down barriers to top-tier sound, so it's not the exception, but the norm. It's what we've been doing for over 50 years, and we're only just getting started.

Our award-winning product lineup includes headphones, lifestyle audio, and premium hi-fi. We also own StreamMagic, our own music streaming platform, plus a music venue and bar called Melomania at our London Bridge HQ.

Work at Cambridge Audio is more than just a job. We're passionate about what we do, and have fun doing it, developing our skills and careers, plus those of the colleagues around us. Learn more at https://cambridgeaudio.com/about-us 

Our Culture

A shared love for music and a commitment to exceptional products and customer experience drive us. With strong team spirit across our five global offices, our core values define our work:

Made By Music -
Inspired by shared passion and independence.
Pride in our product and service -
Obsess over detail, always learning and improving.
Embrace the culture -
Integrity, Innovation, Energy, Openness, Teamwork, Diversity, Flexibility, Fun, Music.
Make an impact -
See it through. Go the extra mile.

About the Role

We are looking for an exceptional person to join Cambridge Audio at a crucial time. We launched our new identity last year and have released a run of category-defining products through 2026, earning awards, critical acclaim and design accolades along the way. We need a Head of Creative to set the creative standard for what comes next. You will be the creative authority for the brand, responsible for the quality, consistency and impact of everything we put into the world, from product film and photography to web, print and live events. You will work closely with the CMO and the Head of PR and lead a small in-house creative studio. The company is small, the goals are demanding and the pace is high.

Key Responsibilities

Set the creative vision:
Define and champion the creative direction across all channels (web, print, video, physical and digital), expressing our pillars: Inspired by music. Crafted by design. Shaped by culture.
Lead the function:
Own the creative team, workflow, budget and resourcing, blending in-house talent with agencies, copywriters and freelancers to deliver first-class work.
Lead the work from concept to delivery:
Art direct every shoot and campaign, owning the quality of the output and the results it delivers.
Own content direction:
Help shape and deliver a content strategy built around our brand pillars that reaches the right audiences, with a clear view of what success looks like.
Unite copy and design:
Direct tone of voice and copy alongside visual work. Own and evolve the brand guidelines and roll them out consistently across global markets.
Connect product and marketing:
Work with Engineering, Product and Marketing to shape creative requirements early in product development.
Be a voice of the brand:
Present the brand and creative direction to listeners, press, retailers and internal teams with confidence.
Build the process:
Put in place the planning, briefing and approval processes that let a small team deliver at pace without compromising standards.
Stay hands-on:
Pitch in and support design at busy times with the right skills and tools.

Requirements

Creative Director/Head of Creative experience leading creative teams and external partners, including remotely, delivering on time and on budget across the campaign lifecycle from concept to delivery.
A strong creative portfolio across multiple mediums and channels, including AV, Stills, Digital and ATL.
Agency or similar in-house studio experience is essential.
Passion for music, contemporary culture and technology.
Deep understanding of how brand contributes to business growth, helping Cambridge Audio reach new audiences, drive product relevance, and open up new opportunities.
Experience in hiring, nurturing and developing creative talent.
Experienced in the use of and experimentation with AI as a copilot, or at least genuinely receptive and excited to experiment with AI design tools and integrate them into your workflow.
Excellent presentation and communication skills, with the confidence to represent the brand.
Strong planning and project management skills in a small, scaling business.

Desirable

Experience in technology and/or lifestyle businesses, Agency or publishing background
Experience repositioning or evolving a brand with heritage
Adobe Creative Suite proficiency and/or Web UX/UI experience.
Understanding of how brand and creative drive business growth, product relevance and new audiences

Personal Profile

Charismatic, personable and easy to work with.
Driven, with the conviction to guide change and the drive to keep the brand relevant and ahead of the curve.

Working Pattern & Duration

Full-time, permanent.

Location

This role is based at our London Bridge HQ on a hybrid basis. We're looking for someone based in or near London who can be in the office regularly.

Compensation

Competitive salary based on experience.

Benefits

Health & Wellbeing

Subsidised private healthcare (50:50 contribution)
Annual wellness benefit pot covering 50% of life-enriching activities
Annual life-enhancement training allowance
24/7 GP and Mental Health assistance

Time & Flexibility

Charity volunteer days - 3 per year to support a cause of your choice
4pm finish on the last Friday of every month

Social & Culture

Regular socials organised by our "Director of Fun"
Annual team trips to surprise destinations
50% off gigs and festivals with our "Passion for Music" benefit

Recognition & Rewards

Profit share scheme
Colleague suggestion scheme to shape the way we work

Equal Opportunities Statement

Cambridge Audio is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender identity, marital status, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. If you need any adjustments to the recruitment process, let us know.

How To Apply

Please click 'APPLY' and it will redirect you to our Careers Page on our website. Complete the form to submit your details with CV and cover letter. All applications will be treated in the strictest confidence.

Please do NOT apply via LinkedIn directly.

Read our candidate privacy notice: https://www.cambridgeaudio.com/candidate-privacy-notice to see how we handle your data.

jobs.title: Senior Creative Director
jobs.description:
TAIT partners with artists, brands, IP holders and place makers to bring culture-defining, never-before-seen experiences to life. With a legacy of innovation spanning over 45 years, TAIT has grown from pioneering in rock ‘n’ roll concert staging to setting the global standard for extraordinary live events and experiences through cutting-edge technology, precision engineering, and creative design. TAIT’s 20 global offices have developed iconic productions and experiences in over 30 countries, all seven continents, and even outer space for renowned performers, theme parks, exhibits, and venues across the globe, including partnerships with Taylor Swift, Cirque Du Soleil, Royal Opera House, Nike, NASA, Bloomberg, Google, Beyoncé, and The Olympics

Position Purpose

The Senior Creative Director position is primarily responsible for leading and contributing to the creative development of a variety of projects for the Company to meet the Client’s expectations and the Company’s quality guidelines. This position includes managing the original creation of new creative material for the Company’s projects, participating and contributing in brainstormings & charrettes, contributing to already developed concepts by others and acting as creative lead on all projects.

This position may include the participation and preparation of other non-project specific assignments, such as speech and editorial writing and preparation, marketing materials copywriting, RFQ/RFP positioning statements, white papers and other writing as deemed necessary by the Company. Participation will be required in presentations, meetings, production meetings, field trips, research and other projects as necessary. The Senior Creative Director will act as a representative of the Company to clients, professional organizations, and the media.

Responsibilities

The Senior Creative Director will set and communicate the creative direction for major, multidisciplinary guest experiences—articulating the big picture in an inspiring way and leading from pitch through final installation. They will drive concepts (including major IPs) in complex stakeholder environments; mentor and manage creative teams; align with business and brand strategy; and ensure operational, financial, and experiential feasibility. They will uphold creative quality, strengthen client relationships, and represent TAIT with passion, clarity, and composure across presentations, industry forums, and solo client engagements.
Visualize and communicate the overarching creative vision in a clear, inspiring, and motivating way.
Lead creative across all phases—concept, design, tender, production, installation/programming—for attractions, exhibits, interactives, and integrated experiences.
Drive pitching and proposals: generate ideas with internal teams; lead kick‑offs and creative work sessions; craft persuasive pitch materials.
Develop, write, and lead IP‑based concepts; ensure brand/IP compliance and alignment across complex stakeholder landscapes.
Manage and or mentor talent (including Creative Directors); inspire cross‑functional teams and model passion, positivity, and creative rigor.
Own narrative deliverables: oversee briefs, summaries, treatments, outlines, narratives, and scripts; augment with mood boards, storyboards, and reference media.
Ensure feasibility and delivery: partner with SMEs to validate operational, financial, and experiential viability; collaborate with PM/PE to manage scope, schedule, budget; identify and mitigate risks; respond constructively to feedback.
Maintain creative quality control throughout the lifecycle, including TAIT senior leadership reviews; lead client/stakeholder presentations and develop presentation materials.
Partner across content and production: collaborate with producers and the Head of Content; incorporate feedback while protecting creative intent.
Manage multiple projects end‑to‑end, keeping an open, adaptive process to accommodate pivots and resource realignment.
Advance business and brand goals: develop creative programs and design concepts that meet client objectives; apply appropriate brand voice and ensure brand compliance.
Optimize workflow and resources to meet timelines and deliverables; align staffing with project priorities.
Work with vendors to realize creative intent and resolve challenges collaboratively.
Research industry trends, technologies, and client context to inform and elevate creative development.
Ensure compliance with company policies and procedures; identify and communicate critical issues and milestones promptly.
Travel domestically and internationally as required.
Contribute to departmental growth through industry representation, competitions, technology exploration, marketing support, and educational outreach.
Additional duties as needed

Position Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Fine Arts, Design, Architecture, Humanities, or related field; Master's degree a plus.
12+ years of demonstrable experience in storytelling, creative ideation & leadership in the industry, including significant experience with high-level stakeholders on major projects.
12+ years of significant demonstrable major client facing and handling experiences.
Significant experience exhibiting creative leadership in service to, and managing the portfolios for, major entertainment industry clients (including project development in the areas of LBE and/or placemaking).
Excellent collaboration skills, and comfortable working as part of several teams simultaneously.
Strong computer skills: Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, Lucid, and Keynote
Proven communication and presentation skills: written and verbal
Understanding of the entertainment industry and participating in or leading a creative process
Proven experience in constantly multitask and handling competing priorities between client business needs, organizational issues, and sound customer relations
Possess judgment to know when to appropriately escalate issues up the chain of command
Excellent diplomatic listening and communication skills, able to handle and resolve conflicts effectively in a firm but fair manner
Able to work both collaboratively and independently while maintaining a high level of productivity in a remote or hybrid setting
Able to work under tight timetables and high-pressure situations
Thrive in a fast-paced environment and able to juggle, shift gears, and maintain a sense of humor; deliver under extreme deadlines and intense business environment
Proactive and solution-oriented when managing issues
Demonstrated experience and ability to provide strong coaching, mentorship, and advocacy to/for all levels and all members of a creative team
Proficiency in English, required.
Proficiency in Arabic, preferred.
Ability to provide a portfolio for the interview process.

We're hiring: Creative Director | Dubai | Full-time

TACTECH New Media
is a Dubai-based creative technology studio working where storytelling, design and technology meet. We create immersive and interactive experiences, digital installations, films, animation/CGI, brand campaigns and content for opening ceremonies and shows.

We're looking for a Creative Director to lead our creative vision from first insight to final execution.

THE ROLE

Lead TACTECH's creative direction across immersive and interactive experiences, digital installations, films, animation/CGI, opening ceremonies, shows and campaigns. Bring the strategic thinking and conceptual discipline of an experienced agency creative leader to every brief, whether or not it is a campaign. Guide ideas from insight and concept through narrative, audience experience, visual development and final execution, in close collaboration with production and technology teams.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Creative strategy and concept leadership

Interpret client and agency briefs, uncover audience and business objectives, and establish a clear strategic creative rationale.
Develop original concepts, storylines, scripts, experience narratives, visitor journeys, creative treatments and presentations for corporate and entertainment projects.
Bring proven campaign thinking - audience insight, big ideas, messaging and consistency across touchpoints - to campaign assignments and apply that same strategic rigor to TACTECH's wider creative work.
Shape UX scripts, user flows and screen-by-screen interactions with designers and developers; define participation or game mechanics only when they add value to a relevant experience.

Art direction and content direction

Direct key visuals, styleframes, storyboards, moodboards, design systems, animation language and presentation materials across content, campaigns and experiences.
Guide creative storytelling and execution for corporate films, opening films, footage-led content, CGI, motion graphics, AI-assisted visuals and relevant live-action productions.
Shape how stories unfold across immersive and large-format screens, opening ceremonies, show sequences and interactive applications, choosing techniques for their creative value.
Protect brand accuracy, typography, visual hierarchy, narrative clarity and consistent creative quality from early concepts through final output.

Creative team leadership and integration

Brief, mentor and review the Art Director, designers, motion artists, and external creative specialists, providing clear and actionable feedback.
Work with the Production Manager to define creative disciplines, resource needs, quality benchmarks and review checkpoints; collaborate with Producers, Technology and Technical Leads to test feasibility early.
Continuously review freelance artists' portfolios, assess creative capabilities and recommend the right specialists for each assignment in coordination with production.
Use AI creative tools proficiently to visualize and communicate ideas through concepts, visual references, styleframes, storyboards and previsualization, while maintaining high creative standards.

WHAT YOU BRING

10+ years of creative experience, including a strong agency background with hands-on campaign concept development and senior creative leadership across experiential, digital, motion/CGI or content work.
A portfolio demonstrating personal ownership of strategy, concepts and finished work across corporate and entertainment assignments, including campaign work as well as content or experiences.
Strong strategic and conceptual judgment, storytelling and script/treatment skills, and the ability to turn complex briefs into distinctive ideas and audience experiences.
Working knowledge of interactive UX and occasional gamified experiences, animation, CGI, screen content and practical physical-digital production constraints.
Confident creative presentation, multidisciplinary team leadership and a collaborative approach to resource and technical feasibility planning.
Hands-on proficiency with contemporary AI-assisted creative tools, with strong judgment about quality, originality and practical application.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Creative ideas demonstrate audience understanding, strategic relevance and originality, whatever the format or channel.
Stories, art direction, UX intent and relevant interaction mechanics translate coherently from creative pitch through implementation.
Internal and external creative teams receive clear briefs, useful reviews and timely decisions; specialists are well matched to projects.
The work demonstrates strong craft and feasibility, strengthens client confidence and elevates the studio portfolio.

ROLE BOUNDARIES AND COLLABORATION

Reporting line:
Managing Director
This is not a film-only director, conventional advertising art director, event-design/fabrication or game-studio position. TACTECH creates strategy-informed concepts, content and technology-led experiences; event operations and physical fabrication, when needed, are handled with specialist partners.

HOW TO APPLY

Submit a CV and a curated portfolio of 4-6 projects showing creative strategy or rationale, your personal concept contribution, the disciplines involved and the finished outcome. Include campaign work and relevant examples across content, immersive/interactive, corporate or entertainment projects.
Apply through the job post or send a direct email to : careers@tactech.digital

Identify emerging digital trends, AI-powered tools, and automation opportunities to improve marketing efficiency and effectiveness.

Ensure digital campaigns, advertising claims, and creative materials comply with applicable regulations and brand guidelines.

You can independently develop a digital media strategy and take ownership of its execution.

Experience with audience segmentation, remarketing, A/B testing, and customer acquisition strategies.

Strong analytical, project management, communication, and stakeholder coordination skills.

Experience managing digital campaigns for healthcare, nutraceutical, wellness, or other regulated consumer products.
Exposure to e-commerce platforms such as Amazon, Noon, or Shopify.
Certifications in Google Ads, Meta Blueprint, HubSpot, or SEO.
Familiarity with Canva, Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar tools.
Experience using AI-powered marketing and automation solutions.

jobs.title: Senior Art Director- MENA, Brand Innovation Lab
jobs.description:
Description

Amazon’s Brand Innovation Lab is looking for a talented, passionate, and a hands-on Creative (Art Director) to conceptualise and create one-of-a-kind campaigns for a wide range of brands across MENA. You’ll partner with Sales leads, Solutions Managers, Producers, and Design Technology and Engineering teams to create first-class customer experiences both online and offline by innovating with the Amazon canvas (Prime Video, Alexa, Twitch, etc.). You’ll lead projects and own client relationships, focusing on creating work that benefits the end customer while pushing the creative envelope from brief to execution, with a focus on our partnerships and sponsorships offering.

From ideation through launch, you will be responsible for delivering ambitious, insightful, and data-driven concepts that translate needs and constraints into customer-focused brand campaign ideas and solutions. You will be equally strong at concept and execution and an expert in leveraging AI tools and workflows, articulating end-to-end creative solutions, and turning that vision into high-quality experiences. This could include video content, user interface designs for voice and screen, interaction models, prototypes, and interactive advertising campaigns. This role will use data and insights to create campaign strategy and concepts, develop designs and the look and feel for experiences, as well as templates for never-before-done brand campaigns and experiences that will solve customer problems, on and off Amazon platforms.

Candidates should have an in-depth understanding of AI tools, Photoshop, Illustrator, PowerPoint, Figma and Webflow, (or an interest to learn Webflow), and understanding of UX design.

The candidate’s portfolio should feature highly creative, award-winning campaigns and ideas that solve customer and advertiser problems through a variety of different media channels, including but not limited to video, social, digital activations, and outdoor. You have strong conceptual, presentation, storytelling, and time management skills, as well as digital media experience, insight-driven and strategic thinking, and of course, an acute attention to detail.

Key job responsibilities

Concept, design (art), and execute innovative ad campaigns and experiences for global brands.

Partner with designers, program managers, developers, strategists, business leads, and producers to create customer-focused solutions that deliver on advertiser objectives.

Independently lead campaigns from brief to execution and collaborate with internal teams, clients, and external agency partners.
Obsessed with understanding customers and making work that delivers both innovation and results.
Present ideas and concepts to clients, agencies, and internally.
Proven ability to ideate for film, print, digital, out-of-home, experiential, and social.
Ability to manage multiple projects at once within budget and deadlines.
Be proactive in developing new products and ideas on behalf of the customer.

A day in the life

Partnering with a variety of brands, media, and creative agencies to work on innovative campaigns for travel and tourism, automotive, finance, consumables, telecommunication etc.
From designing brand experiences (digital and physical), from documentary films in Prime Video to Alexa branded experiences, you will always strive to create never-before-done ideas.
Presenting a campaign to senior brand clients and their partners in creative and media agencies.
Reviewing edits and work in progress with your partners, collecting and responding to feedback in order to meet the highest creative standards.
Work with your team on proactive projects and initiatives and bring them to life.

About The Team

The Brand Innovation Lab is Amazon' Ads Innovation team dedicated to creating one-of-a-kind campaigns and activations for global advertisers.

Leveraging the full Amazon canvas: custom landing pages, Alexa, Fire TV, Twitch, Prime Video, and more. We build campaigns that reach millions of customers across digital channels and in the real world.

The team also works on Prime Video IP and brands, developing co-branded full-funnel campaigns.

Basic Qualifications

Experience in driving compelling creative strategy and execution at an agency or in-house creative team
Experience communicating and delivering presentations to customers, stakeholders, and/or teammates
In-depth understanding of industry design tools (Ex. Adobe Creative Cloud, Figma), and a basic understanding of UX design and UX design Tools (ie. Webflow)

Preferred Qualifications

Knowledge of InDesign, Photoshop, Illustrator, Keynote
Experience developing cross-functional relationships with product, consumer research and marketing teams to develop strategy and consumer insights that drive compelling creative executions
Experience leading creative development of innovative creative from concept to delivery
Experience presenting creative concepts effectively to senior executives
Experience managing multiple projects and meeting aggressive deadlines
Experience in developing creative concepts and executing campaigns for brand partnerships and/or sponsorships

jobs.description:
Company Description

At Saatchi & Saatchi Health, we believe in making the impossible possible in health. We partner with our clients to turn complexity into clarity, ideas into impact, and ambition into real-world outcomes. By combining creativity, data, and technology, we create work that doesn’t just reach people--it moves them, connects with them, and makes a difference in their lives. Because when our people bring curiosity and courage to the work, we unlock new possibilities for our clients, and better outcomes for the patients they serve. We’re here to push what health can be. And to make it matter.

Overview

The Associate Creative Director (art) is involved in the development of creative concepts, working with all disciplines in the agency including copywriters and designers to build cohesive and effective campaigns.

Their focus is on the visual design and art direction of advertising campaigns. They ensure the visual design aligns with the overall creative direction and strategy of the campaign, and that it effectively communicates the desired message to the target audience.

As a close ally of the Creative Director, they are stepping into a managerial role to mentor team members, especially art directors and designers. In addition, they oversee the production of the visual elements of the campaign, ensuring they are executed to the highest standards.

The Associate Creative Director, Art is responsible for leading the creative work. This leadership role includes assigning teams, inspiring those teams to consistently produce exceptional concepts and final work, and working closely with account management to ensure that our clients are satisfied with the quality of our creative work.

Works with the Creative Director to address performance, workflow, and quality issues and develop long-range plans for the team.
Helps develop and review creative briefs that provide strategic insight(s) and creative inspiration
Promote a culture of creative quality and accountability and ensure creative deliverables meet both our clients’ expectations and our own standards of excellence

Responsibilities

People & Leadership *

Seeks others' feedback to develop self-awareness, strengths and address development area.
Is able to proactively raise issues to improve effective team working and collaboration.
Is able to communicate confidently in a clear, concise and articulate manner.
Collaborates with stakeholders and embraces an inclusive based environment.
Is able to make valuable contributions to discussions and brainstorming sessions, providing insight and point of view.
Able to build relationships quickly with others and engages personally with peers and clients.
Treats others with respect, listens to other perspectives, especially when they are different from own.
Able to tackle problems in a timely manner and develop contingency plans that focus on problem resolution.
Drives a culture of trust with Peers, clients and all other stakeholders.

Innovative & Analytical Mindset *

Develops and reviews creative briefs that provide strategic insight(s) and creative inspiration
Demonstrates to clients that an understanding of their marketing challenges and is responsive to their strategic needs in proposing creative solutions.

Trains new employees on responsibilities and agency procedures, and works with current creative staff to help them achieve professional and personal goals.
Works with the upper management team to plan and pursue continuing strategic growth of agency billings and participate in new business pitch opportunities.
Develops and evaluates creative concepts, copy and art, at pre-determined points and providing direction prior to review by account management.
Sets high creative standards that lead to a body of work that creates enthusiastic customers and clients, and is consistently recognized by agency management as on strategy and unique.
Leads the creative efforts on new business assignments, as needed.
Ensures that creative presentations to the client meet the highest professional standards.
Manages the workload for assigned book of business to maximize the productivity and quality of work from the creative staff.
Imparts outdoor industry expertise and experience to the team.
Conceives and create experience design solutions that meet client objectives
Effectively communicate creative concepts and strategies to both clients and our internal team.
Designing comps, storyboards, initial graphic concepts, and final deliverables
Brainstorms and developing campaigns while working with clients on multiple projects at once
Assists the Creative Director to improve the Creative group’s technical and creative performance.
Help ensure that deadlines and budgets are met.
Ideates, writes and executes original and iconic creative concepts in response to client briefs, objectives or goals.
Extends client relationships and explore new ways to deliver value.
Presents, shares and reviews creative work with Executive Creative Director/s, Account Management and Planning Leads as well as members of the Management Team
Manages multiple projects from concept through to completion, working with both in-house resources and third-party vendors
Collaborates effectively with Account Management, Planning and the broader creative team to develop disruptive and iconic work
Provides leadership and professional development to department staff
Mentors and trains team members, write performance reviews, and allocate work
Set goals and KPIs for each team member, and works with them to achieve these.

Self *

Is able to take ownership for actions and deals with consequences in a mature manner.
Able to adjust performance based on experiences and feedback and showcases agility and flexibility.
Displays openness to the ideas of others and leverages them when beneficial for the business.
Showcases curiosity and open mindset towards new ways of doing things.
Is able to set high impact objectives and goes above and beyond to exceed performance.
Demonstrates the Growth Mindset and is able to take ownership of personal development and growth.
Capable of constructively challenging the status-quo and takes risks to challenge internal and external perspectives.
Approaches situations and individuals with honesty, integrity and humbleness.
Displays resilience and maintains drives and a positive outlook when faced with challenges.

Qualifications

6+ years of agency experience with primarily an Art background
A proven track record of conceptual creative ability and judgment
Successful client contact experience and ability to grow business organically
The ability to work collaboratively with account management
Excellent presentation skills
Successful experience in managing creatives
The availability and commitment to work extra hours as needed to ensure client satisfaction
Demonstrated experience in events (client/brand)
Understanding of consumer behaviours and industry trends

We’re looking for a hands-on Digital Marketing & Web Development Specialist to develop our Next.js websites, support PPC campaigns across advertising platforms, and turn website traffic into qualified enquiries and sales.

You’ll use Claude Code to build and improve websites and landing pages, manage paid advertising, and collaborate with our existing Meta advertising specialist.

Responsibilities

• Build, maintain, and improve our Next.js and React websites, using Claude Code as part of your development workflow.
• Create campaign landing pages and improve website speed, mobile usability, and conversion rates.
• Plan, manage, and optimise PPC campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram), Microsoft Advertising, and other relevant paid channels.
• Work alongside our existing Meta specialist on campaign delivery, testing, landing pages, and tracking, with clearly agreed responsibilities.
• Manage keyword research, audience targeting, bidding, budgets, ad copy, and retargeting.
• Set up and maintain Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, advertising pixels, and conversion tracking.
• Connect website forms to CRM systems and marketing automation tools.
• Improve technical SEO, site structure, metadata, and indexing.
• Test landing pages, forms, and calls to action to improve campaign results.
• Report clearly on advertising spend, lead quality, cost per acquisition, and return on advertising spend where measurable.

Requirements

• Practical experience developing websites with Next.js, React, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
• Proficiency with Claude Code, including reviewing, testing, and troubleshooting the code it produces.
• Experience working with existing codebases, Git, and website deployment workflows.
• Hands-on experience with Google Ads and Meta Ads, plus the ability to work across other PPC platforms.
• Understanding of campaign optimisation, conversion tracking, attribution, and landing page performance.
• Confidence using Google Analytics 4 and Google Tag Manager.
• Familiarity with APIs, CRM integrations, hosting, and domain management.
• Strong written and spoken English.
• Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with marketing specialists.
• Availability to work on-site in Dubai Media City.

• Vercel deployment and hosting.
• Tailwind CSS and responsive interface development.
• Meta Conversions API and server-side tracking.
• Technical SEO for Next.js websites.
• CRM systems, email marketing, and automation.
• Basic design skills and experience working with brand guidelines.

Please send your CV and a short introduction, along with:

• Two websites or landing pages you’ve worked on, ideally built with Next.js or React, explaining your contribution.

instashop, headquartered in Dubai, is the leading online local marketplace in the UAE and Egypt . Since joining the Delivery Hero family in 2020, the global leader in online food delivery and q-commerce, instashop has been setting the standard for excellence and convenience in the region.

With a dynamic and motivated team fueled by passion and innovation, every day at instashop is an opportunity for growth and success. As we continue to grow, our team keeps expanding across the UAE, Egypt and Greece, and we’re always on the lookout for new talents to join us on our success journey.

Job Description

This is an individual contributor role on the Performance Marketing team. You will own the day-to-day execution of paid campaigns across channels, manage budgets, and drive customer acquisition for instashop.

You will work directly with the Head of Marketing at instashop on Marcomms strategy, incentive tracking, and business performance analysis, but also work as a dotted line with Talabat’s performance marketing lead. This is a hybrid role: part campaign executor, part strategic analyst. You need to be comfortable switching between both.

The team expects you to run lean. That means embedding AI into your workflow, cutting manual steps wherever possible, and operating at a pace that matches the business.

Campaign Execution

Own end-to-end campaign setup, bidding, and optimisation across Meta, TikTok, and other paid channels.
Take creatives live, test new formats, and iterate based on performance data.
Manage daily budget allocation and pacing to hit CAC targets.
Monitor campaign health and flag issues before they compound.

Performance Analysis

Analyse campaign performance across the full funnel, from impression to conversion.
Build and maintain regular performance reports for the Head of Marketing and senior stakeholders across the two main markets (UAE & Egypt)
Track incentive performance and contribute to business performance reviews.
Identify CAC efficiency opportunities and bring data-backed recommendations.

Experimentation

Design and run A/B tests on creatives, audiences, bids, and landing experiences.
Document test hypotheses, results, and learnings in a structured way.
Propose new experiments based on platform signals, competitive benchmarks, and your own analysis.

Strategy and Marcomms Collaboration

Work closely with the Head of Marketing at instashop on marketing communications planning and calendar.
Support incentive design and tracking, aligning promotional activity with acquisition goals.
Contribute to quarterly planning with performance data and channel insights.

Qualifications

Platform Depth

Strong working knowledge of Meta Ads Manager: campaign structures, bidding strategies, Advantage+ campaigns, and creative best practices.
Working knowledge of TikTok Ads: smart campaigns, TopView, In-Feed, and short-form content performance patterns.
Familiarity with how short-form content (Reels, TikToks) behaves differently in paid vs organic and how to use that to brief or iterate on creative.
Working knowledge of other platforms such as Google, Apple Ads, Snapchat etc.
Understanding of attribution and MMP mechanics: how platforms like Adjust or AppsFlyer measure installs, events, and in-app revenue, and where discrepancies come from.

AI-First Way of Working

You are expected to use AI tools actively in your day-to-day: for reporting, analysis, brief writing, and workflow automation.
The goal is to reduce manual overhead, not just stay busy. If you are doing something repetitive that a well-prompted tool can do, you should already be automating it.
Comfort with prompt engineering and integrating AI outputs into real workflows is a strong plus.

Analytical Rigour

You can pull data, build a view, and explain what it means without being hand-held.
You understand incrementality vs. last-touch attribution, and you can have an informed conversation about channel contribution.
You know what CAC, LTV, ROAS, and CPM mean in practice, not just as definitions.

Speed and Ownership

You do not wait to be told what is wrong. You monitor, spot it, and fix it or flag it.
You manage your own workload across campaigns and strategic tasks without dropping either.
Fast-paced environment is not a cliche here. It is the actual pace of this team.

Qualifications

3 to 5 years of hands-on performance marketing experience, with at least 2 years focused on paid social.
Experience managing and allocating performance marketing budgets across channels and markets with the ability to optimize spend based business objectives.
Proven track record running Meta and TikTok campaigns, not just setting them up.
Experience working with MMPs (Adjust, AppsFlyer, or equivalent) and understanding attribution at a platform level.
Exposure to q-commerce, food delivery, or e-commerce is a strong plus.
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field.

Nice to Have

Experience running campaigns across both brand and performance objectives simultaneously.
Experience briefing creative teams and giving structured feedback on short-form video assets.
Hands-on use of AI tools in a marketing context (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar).

The Senior Creative Director position is primarily responsible for leading and contributing to the creative development of a variety of projects for the Company to meet the Client’s expectations and the Company’s quality guidelines. This position includes managing the original creation of new creative material for the Company’s projects, participating and contributing in brainstormings & charrettes, contributing to already developed concepts by others and acting as creative lead on all projects.

This position may include the participation and preparation of other non-project specific assignments, such as speech and editorial writing and preparation, marketing materials copywriting, RFQ/RFP positioning statements, white papers and other writing as deemed necessary by the Company. The Senior Creative Director will set and communicate the creative direction for major, multidisciplinary guest experiences—articulating the big picture in an inspiring way and leading from pitch through final installation. They will drive concepts (including major IPs) in complex stakeholder environments; mentor and manage creative teams; align with business and brand strategy; and ensure operational, financial, and experiential feasibility.
